text:
lee: @channel security advisory: we discovered a misconfiguration in the internal credential broker that temporarily exposed a subset of ephemeral deploy tokens to a read-only path. No external exfil detected, but we need immediate scoped rotations and verification.

toni: TL;DR - affected: tokens issued between 2026-04-15T00:00Z and 2026-04-15T09:30Z for services tagged env=prod and role=deploy. Required: rotate those tokens, revoke any long-lived backups, and run integration smoke tests.

secbot: Alert 2026-04-15T09:35Z - credential-broker:public-read-path anomaly. Risk: medium -> escalate.

lee: Action items (owners):
- By 2026-04-15 15:00 UTC: Build-team to generate rotation list and push new tokens to Secrets Manager path /prod/deploy/tokens/rotated-2145001234.
- By 2026-04-15 18:00 UTC: All service owners to update running jobs/runners using those tokens and run smoke tests.
- 2026-04-16: Security will run a verification scan and close the incident if clean.

sam: How do we detect affected jobs?

toni: We'll publish a CSV with token IDs and impacted services to the playbook (internal link). Quick check: list secrets with tag rotated: false in the /prod/deploy prefix.

lee: If you cannot rotate by deadline, file an exception with compensating controls and contact sec-oncall.

build-team: Acknowledged. We'll post the rotation CSV in 30m and start rotating CI runners first.

lee: Thanks. Postmortem and follow-up hardening (preventing public-read paths) will be published tomorrow. Please escalate any anomalous behavior immediately.
